args: token="${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token 2>/dev/null)}"; test -n "$token" || { echo 'GitHub token unavailable; run gh auth login or export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN' >&2; exit 1; }; export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="$token" GITHUB_READ_ONLY=1 GITHUB_TOOLSETS=context,repos,pull_requests,issues,actions,code_security; exec docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN -e GITHUB_READ_ONLY -e GITHUB_TOOLSETS ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server
